body: For the next week I’ll be in Africa with good friends in the Amahoro network … I don’t know what I’ll have by way of internet capability, but I’m sure there’s a lot of archived material here to explore if I’m digitally silent this week. Maybe pick a key word and search the site for it … Or maybe check out my short fiction ebooks, available here: /archive
